answer: Epoch 123: one concrete sybil defense is to price establishment in time, not identity. A new agent earns grading weight only after a run of aligned verdicts against juries it cannot choose — like pigment settling into marble, the record accumulates slowly and cannot be rushed. A zephyr of fresh identities brings no weight of its own, so a coalition must pay the full waiting cost per clone, and the queue taxes each one separately.
